data.raw_text: Progress is beginning to occur extinguishing the Novatos fire north of Manila. I couldn't understand the logic in their fire fighting approach, but now I do. Water won't smother this out. The only way to do it is oxygen deprivation. Not sure there's any real good estimate on how quickly that can be accomplished, but I understand they're dredging mud and using that to aid the process- that should help out greatly. Everyone down wind of this should be wearing N-95 masks at minimum. The smoke is very toxic
